paragraphs.S04.C000.P000: At the lookout, the wind tried to wrench the car doors open. Eric got out first, walked around, and held Alice's door.
paragraphs.S04.C000.P002: “I know. I'm holding the door, not you.”
paragraphs.S04.C000.P003: He let go as soon as both of Alice's feet were on the ground.
paragraphs.S04.C000.P004: The road ran between dark cliffs. Nick filmed the wide shot, sometimes lowering the camera simply to look. Damir pulled his hat too far down, and Alice remembered how she used to laugh when his eyebrows disappeared in winter.
paragraphs.S04.C000.P007: “That was your 'nothing from the past' face.”
paragraphs.S04.C000.P012: Nick heard them and turned the camera their way, but stopped before pressing record.
paragraphs.S04.C000.P013: “Can I film this? It's the first time you two have looked like people instead of witnesses waiting for a notary.”
paragraphs.S04.C000.P014: Alice looked at Damir. He shrugged: her decision.

S04.C002.title: A. Allow a short shared shot (`consent.camera=accepted`)

paragraphs.S04.C002.P001: Nick filmed for a few seconds. The wind swallowed Damir's words, Alice laughed and turned away from the lens, and Nick stopped recording. He showed her the screen. She kept the beginning and asked him to remove the moment when she covered her face with her hand. Nick trimmed it in front of her.

S04.C003.title: B. Ask him to put the camera away (`consent.camera=declined_respected`)

paragraphs.S04.C003.P000: “Let's leave the camera off for now.”
paragraphs.S04.C003.P001: Nick lowered the camera. Alice expected the usual “I was only filming for myself,” but he simply zipped the case shut.
paragraphs.S04.C003.P002: “All right. Sometimes I want to just remember things too.”
paragraphs.S04.C003.P003: He walked beside her and asked how Damir had managed to make her laugh with one word. Alice did not answer, but she stopped checking whether the camera had come up again.

S04.C004.title: C. Suggest a shot of the whole group (`consent.camera=negotiated`)

paragraphs.S04.C004.P000: “If we're taking a shot, make it all four of us. And not for the film until we've seen it.”
paragraphs.S04.C004.P001: Nick set the camera on the railing, switched on the timer, and called for Eric. Eric reached them at the last second and bent awkwardly to fit in the frame.
paragraphs.S04.C004.P002: On the screen, they still looked like strangers, but they were standing closer together than they had the day before at the airport. Eric asked Alice to send him the picture. Nick promised to send it to everyone first and show it to no one without their consent.

paragraphs.S04.C005.P000: They walked on. Eric told a short story about trying to jump a stream as a child and losing a boot. Nick began searching for the site of this achievement. Damir asked Alice if her hands were cold and accepted her no without checking again.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P001: At the edge of the lookout, Alice fell a few steps behind. A wet path ran between two stone walls. Eric was already waiting ahead; she wanted to catch up before he decided she had stopped again for a note.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P002: Nick wrestled with his hood in the wind. Damir kept to the side, not moving closer without an invitation.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P003: Alice put her notebook in her pocket. Until they reached the car, she decided not to write anything down.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P004: At the next fork, Eric suggested a shorter path to the water. The road was level, but the wind was stronger there. They reached the shore of a small lake and found a wooden platform with a single red child's mitten left on it.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P005: “Iceland has a plot now,” Nick said. “The lost mitten is looking for its owner.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P006: “Don't shoot a close-up,” Alice said. “Otherwise the viewer will expect us to find the owner.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P009: Nick picked up the mitten between two fingers.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P011: “Leave it there,” Eric said. “People come back for things they've lost.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P013: “Sometimes a story ends with the thing waiting where it was forgotten.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P016: Eric caught the question and did not pretend they were still talking about the mitten.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P018: Damir stood by the water, the wind pressing his jacket against his back. Alice knew he had heard. He did not turn around.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P019: Nick set the mitten on the post by the entrance and filmed a wide shot without zooming in.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P021: “At least it doesn't promise an ending,” Alice said.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P022: They walked along the water. The path was wide enough to walk in pairs and uneven enough to keep changing the pairs.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P024: “Do you always check what a story is promising?” he asked.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P027: “In life, promises usually come with fine print.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P029: “It sounds like someone who reads contracts.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P030: Nick smiled but did not draw out a confession. Instead, he showed her a frame: the red mitten, the gray lake, two blurred figures far ahead.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P032: “Are Eric and Damir the two up there?” Alice asked.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P033: “Yes. I was trying to film the mitten, and they wandered into the shot.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P034: “I didn't recognize them. They got far away.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P035: Nick enlarged the image, but their faces stayed blurred. Alice did not ask him to delete the frame: she was interested in the abandoned thing, not in herself.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P036: Then Nick sped up to film Eric, and Damir came alongside her.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P037: “I wasn't trying to overhear,” he said.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P038: “We were talking in the wind ten meters away from you.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P041: “Nothing. I just don't want every sentence to become a conversation about us.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P044: “Though I would have taken the mitten,” Damir said. “Left a note and brought it to the café.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P045: “Of course. You can't leave a problem on a post.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P047: Alice looked back at the red dot behind them.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P049: At the end of the path, there was a bench. Eric took a small bar of chocolate from his backpack and divided it into four uneven pieces. Nick got the smallest.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P050: “What did I do to deserve that?” he asked.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P052: Nick traded pieces with Alice without asking, then froze.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P057: “Excellent. Consent obtained retroactively. The lawyers are crying.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P058: “Ask before the diplomatic operation next time.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P060: They drove back to Reykjavík by a different road. Nick fell asleep with the camera against his chest. Damir read the clinic's letter. Eric turned the heat up without asking who was cold, then lowered the window by a centimeter a minute later and admitted he had overdone it.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P061: “Do you always fix everything immediately?” Alice asked.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P065: She thought of Damir. Two years ago, she had not said soon enough how much his decision frightened her. He had not asked directly enough. Each of them had taken the other's silence for an answer.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P069: Eric gave her a quick look.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P072: “Did I wake up in the middle of philosophy?”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P073: “No,” Alice said. “We were discussing the heating.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P075: At the guesthouse, they found the parking space occupied by a small blue car. Eric got out, checked the sign, and came back.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P076: “We'll wait five minutes. Then we'll unload here.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P077: Nick looked at the narrow street.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P078: “I can film us heroically carrying suitcases twenty meters.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P079: “Only if you take mine,” Alice said.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P081: Damir was already getting the bags out.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P083: “I'll take it,” Nick said, lifting Alice's suitcase by the handle.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P084: The blue car left a minute later. Eric did not call everyone back; they had already reached the door. For some reason, Alice liked his ability not to turn a minor failure into another operation.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P085: In the sitting room, Nick opened his laptop and showed them his first material. Not a film, but several short shots: rain on glass, Eric's hands on the map, Damir's cup on the windowsill, boots on the path, and the soggy sign.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P086: “There are hardly any people,” Alice said.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P087: “I don't know how to film them yet.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P090: He switched to the frame of Alice laughing in the shop.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P095: Eric stood behind the sofa, looking at his own hands on the screen.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P098: “Convenient profession. Everything can be blamed on the light.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P099: “In yours, everything can be blamed on the weather.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P100: Damir sat on the arm of the sofa. His cup appeared on the screen, but not his face.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P102: Nick understood without asking what he meant.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P103: “If you want to be in the frame, tell me.”
paragraphs.S04.C005.P104: Alice watched them and suddenly felt that the trip had really begun. Not at the airport, not on the road, and not between the cliffs. It began now, when they saw themselves through someone else's eyes and did not argue that the version was wrong.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P105: Later, Alice was alone in the sitting room. A message from Marina blinked on her phone: “How is the beginning going? Same deadline—after day four.” Alice wrote, “We've arrived in a country where the weather changes plans faster than people do,” and deleted it.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P106: Then: “Four people are crossing Iceland because each of them needs to make a decision,” and deleted that too.
paragraphs.S04.C005.P107: Finally, she left the document blank. The first two days had not earned a conclusion yet.

paragraphs.S04.C006.P000: By the path, Damir raised his phone as if he wanted to ask something, but saw her message from yesterday and simply smiled. Alice recognized the smile and did not look away.

paragraphs.S04.C007.P000: When Damir caught up with the group, Alice met his eyes without needing to return to yesterday's conversation. She liked that he understood her silence.
